rules.title: The rules of the game
rules.intro: The app becomes a farm game: the map is home, the weekly ritual is the mission and every feature is a place or a move. Nobody competes with anybody; the only score is your own farm growing.

ritual.title: Weekly ritual
ritual.text: The mission is the week's flow. Each step lights up by itself when the action happens.

tree.title: The farm tree
tree.text: Each closed ritual grows a branch. A skipped week freezes the tree; nothing withers, nothing is lost.
tree.yours_one: Your tree: {{stage}}, with {{count}} closed ritual. It shows on the map's free land.
tree.yours_other: Your tree: {{stage}}, with {{count}} closed rituals. It shows on the map's free land.

broto.title: Broto, the guide
broto.text: Says the next step in one sentence, unhurried and without exclamation marks.
broto.calm: All up to date. Enjoy the shade.

fresh.title: Freshness in the storehouse
fresh.text: Shelf life became a life bar on every crate, always with the word next to it.
fresh.note: An expired crate leaves the market list and asks for an adjustment: loss, eaten or gift.

seeds.title: Saved seeds
seeds.text: Personal achievements. They stay in the chest, never on a public list.

never.title: What the game never does
never.ranking: Rankings, public scores or comparing farms.
never.countdown: Countdowns, lost lives or streaks that reset.
never.account: Ask for an account, internet, or send data out unless you export it.
never.truth: Trade the storehouse's truth for points: quantities are always real.
never.hide: Hide features: everything the app had is still one tap away.
